race.comment: MUSIC FEVER (7) resumed with a determined Beaudesert win and has the better established 1200m credentials, so she is the clear danger if she carries that first-up form forward. IMPENDOR (3) is suited back from Saturday company after a wide, interrupted Randwick run and his track-distance record keeps him right in the winning mix. TOPHET (5) was in good touch last campaign and resumes off two trials. Should be making his presence felt. BETTER SWEET (9) kicked off the prep in good style here when scoring over the 800m burner. Hasn't gone on with it but is rock-hard fit and deserves consideration.
